programmes.d: A compulsive gambler cajoles his friend to use his telekinesis to affect the results of the gambling tables in Las Vegas.
A hobo, clown, bagpipe player, ballerina and military officer are trapped in a huge cylinder.
A bank teller, Henry Bemis, longs for time alone to read books. He gets his wish...
A playwright makes characters come to life.
A ventriloquist is convinced that his dummy, Willie, is alive and evil. He makes plans for a new act with a new dummy: plans that Willie doesn't support!
Bunny receives a ring from her fan club in her home town. In the ring she sees the faces of people from her hometown telling her she's needed there so she returns home.
A widower buys a robot grandmother for his three children.
Oliver Crangle is a bitter, prejudiced man. Through unknown means, he intends to shrink every evil person in the world at four o'clock.

After successfully stealing a gold shipment, a group of criminals and their scientist accomplice put themselves in suspended animation in a remote desert cave. When they awaken decades later, complications ensue when their truck is destroyed.
A reporter finds himself trapped in a small town where the people have extraordinary powers.
Following a frantic phone call about a crashed spaceship, two policeman try and determine who among the passengers of a bus at a snowed-in roadside diner is from another world.
An astronaut declares himself a god when his ship lands on a planet populated by people smaller than ants.
On a hunting trip, Hyder Simpson and his dog Rip dive into a lake after a raccoon. When he gets home he finds that no one can see or hear him.
Just before being hanged for shooting a man in the back, a man in 1880 is transported into the year 1959 by a professor who soon realizes that he has brought forward a savage killer.
Riding home on the train one day, a man falls asleep and dreams it is 1880, and he is entering a small town called Willoughby.
David Gurney wakes up to find that no one - his wife, his co-workers, his best friend, not even his own mother knows him.
A World War I flying ace flies through a mysterious cloud - and lands at a modern U.S. air base in the year 1959!

Awakened by the cries of their daughter Bettina, Chris and Ruth Miller enter her room to find that she has vanished - even though they still hear her crying for help. Chris' physicist friend Bill thinks she moved into another dimension.
A man's wish to listen to loud noise backfires.
A scientist arranges to have his human-looking robot pitch for the struggling local baseball team.
A man named Benteen leads a colony of Americans stranded on a desert planet for 30 years.
Bartlett Finchley's paranoia about the machines around proves true.

An elderly private school teacher wonders if his life has meant anything as he contemplates suicide on Christmas Eve and is reminded by former students that he has, indeed, had an impact on their lives.
Two unhappy children find a happy escape in a swimming pool.
A has-been, drunk gunslinger finds his fast-draw abilities magically restored.
Jeff Myrtlebank comes back to life at his own funeral and soon begins to act very strangely...
A man and a woman, on opposite sides of a future war, encounter each other in a deserted town.
Confederacy scout Sgt. Joseph Paradine finds a town full of Union soldiers, and an old man who claims he used witchcraft to paralyze them.
Passing through the sound barrier a commercial airliner inadvertently travels back in time.

After a derelict Santa Claus is fired on Christmas Eve, he finds a mysterious bag that gives out presents. With this bag he sets out to fulfill his one wish - to see the less fortunate inherit the bounties of Christmas.
